name: SMACNA HVAC Duct Construction Standards
description: SMACNA's HVAC Duct Construction Standards — Metal and Flexible, together with the associated HVAC Air Duct Leakage Test Manual, define construction gauge, reinforcement, sealing and permitted leakage by pressure class. They are industry consensus standards rather than law, but they are almost always incorporated by reference into mechanical specifications, which makes them contractually binding on the project. For a fabrication shop the auditable questions are which pressure class was specified, whether the fabrication matches it, and whether leakage testing was performed and recorded when the specification called for it.
scope: Sheet metal fabrication shops and mechanical contractors constructing and installing HVAC ductwork

families.name: Fabrication to Specified Pressure Class
families.description: Getting the construction right for the duty the specification set.

controls.name: Pressure Class Determination from Specification
controls.description: The pressure class and seal class required by the project specification are identified before fabrication and recorded on the shop drawing and fabrication ticket.

controls.name: Gauge, Reinforcement and Construction
controls.description: Metal gauge, joint type, reinforcement spacing and hanger selection match the SMACNA table for the pressure class and duct dimension.

controls.name: Sealing to Seal Class
controls.description: Transverse joints, longitudinal seams and duct-wall penetrations are sealed to the specified seal class using approved sealant, applied to manufacturer requirement.

controls.name: Shop Drawing Review and Approval
controls.description: Shop drawings are reviewed against the specification and approved before fabrication, with the approved revision controlled at the point of fabrication.

families.name: Testing, Handover and Nonconformance
families.description: Proving the duct performs as specified.

controls.name: Duct Leakage Testing
controls.description: Where the specification requires it, leakage testing is performed to the SMACNA test manual on the specified portion of the system, with allowable leakage calculated and results recorded.

controls.name: Test Instrument Calibration
controls.description: Instruments used for leakage and airflow measurement are calibrated at the required interval with certificates retained.

controls.name: Nonconforming Fabrication
controls.description: Fabrication not meeting the specified class is identified, dispositioned by an authorized person, and reworked or accepted by documented concession.

controls.name: Handover Documentation
controls.description: As-built drawings, test records and material data are compiled and handed over, with copies retained.
